description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thudella, Ja-Ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512200
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and identities, and land title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
